legend.note: FAIL = not done, broken, or rejected. PASS = human verified after implement — verify commands green. The agent never sets PASS.
legend.priority: lower number = higher priority; agent picks the highest-priority FAIL
legend.verify: runnable test command or command sequence — not prose
